name: Auri Grow India Limited
summary: Auri Grow India Ltd. operates within the Indian market, specializing in the production and distribution of electronic cables and conductors. Its extensive product portfolio encompasses Aluminum Conductor Steel Reinforced (ACSR), standard conductor wire, Aluminum Alloy Conductors (AAC), and Aerial Bunched (AB) cables. Furthermore, the company supplies stay and DPC (Double Paper Covered) wires, alongside XLP (Cross-linked Polyethylene) coated wires and conductors. The firm, which was established in 1987, changed its name from Godha Cabcon & Insulation Limited to Auri Grow India Limited in October 2025. Its operations are headquartered in Indore, India.
